_comment: docs/components/lane-model.md — the Lite lane. A plainly simple task: the classifier should return intent=task, complexity=simple (obvious steps). It must NOT open a task-run (no PlanWorkflow, turns.plan_id stays null), NOT run SkillDiscover/ToolDiscover, NOT seed a PLAN.md ledger — only MemoryRetrieve, staged under the turn's own id. lite-simple-task.expect.sh checks exactly that. If the real classifier says moderate/complex instead, the check reads the classify log line and skips rather than failing.
